osImage.description: OS image to initialize the instance. [Available images](https://cloud.google.com/bare-metal/docs/bms-planning#server_configurations)

name.description: The name of the instance config.

logicalInterfaces.description: List of logical interfaces for the instance. The number of logical interfaces will be the same as number of hardware bond/nic on the chosen network template. Filled if InstanceConfig.multivlan_config is true.

hyperthreading.description: Whether the instance should be provisioned with Hyperthreading enabled.

id.description: A transient unique identifier to identify an instance within an ProvisioningConfig request.

accountNetworksEnabled.description: If true networks can be from different projects of the same vendor account.

enumDescriptions: Instance part of single client network and single private network.
Instance part of multiple (or single) client networks and private networks.
networkConfig.description: The type of network configuration on the instance.

privateNetwork.description: Private network address, if any. Filled if InstanceConfig.multivlan_config is false.

userNote.description: User note field, it can be used by customers to add additional information for the BMS Ops team .

networkTemplate.description: Server network template name. Filled if InstanceConfig.multivlan_config is true.

sshKeyNames.description: Optional. List of names of ssh keys used to provision the instance.

kmsKeyVersion.description: Name of the KMS crypto key version used to encrypt the initial passwords. The key has to have ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT purpose.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results from the server.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

ListNetworksResponse.description: Response message containing the list of networks.

ResetInstanceResponse.description: Response message from resetting a server.

SSHKey.description: An SSH key, used for authorizing with the interactive serial console feature.

name.description: Output only. The name of this SSH key. Currently, the only valid value for the location is "global".

publicKey.description: The public SSH key. This must be in OpenSSH .authorized_keys format.

UserAccount.description: User account provisioned for the customer.

kmsKeyVersion.description: KMS CryptoKey Version used to encrypt the password.

email.description: Optional. Email provided to send a confirmation with provisioning config to.

EvictVolumeRequest.description: Request for skip volume cooloff and delete it.

StartInstanceResponse.description: Response message from starting a server.

sshKeys.description: Optional. List of SSH Keys used during instance provisioning.

luns.description: Immutable. List of LUNs associated with this server.

enumDescriptions: The server is in an unknown state.
state.description: Output only. The state of the server.

logicalInterfaces.description: List of logical interfaces for the instance. The number of logical interfaces will be the same as number of hardware bond/nic on the chosen network template. For the non-multivlan configurations (for eg, existing servers) that use existing default network template (bondaa-bondaa), both the Instance.networks field and the Instance.logical_interfaces fields will be filled to ensure backward compatibility. For the others, only Instance.logical_interfaces will be filled.

networkTemplate.description: Instance network template name. For eg, bondaa-bondaa, bondab-nic, etc. Generally, the template name follows the syntax of "bond" or "nic".

firmwareVersion.description: Output only. The firmware version for the instance.

kmsKeyVersion.description: Optional. Name of the KMS crypto key version used to encrypt the initial passwords. The key has to have ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT purpose. Format is `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyring}/cryptoKeys/{key}/cryptoKeyVersions/{version}`.

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Instance can only be connected to the assets (networks, volumes) allocated in the same pod.

interactiveSerialConsoleEnabled.description: Output only. True if the interactive serial console feature is enabled for the instance, false otherwise. The default value is false.

updateTime.description: Output only. Update a time stamp.

volumes.description: Input only. List of Volumes to attach to this Instance on creation. This field won't be populated in Get/List responses.

name.description: Immutable. The resource name of this `Instance`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}`

workloadProfile.description: The workload profile for the instance.
enumDescriptions: The workload profile is in an unknown state.

hyperthreadingEnabled.description: True if you enable hyperthreading for the server, otherwise false. The default value is false.

networks.description: Output only. List of networks associated with this server.

loginInfo.description: Output only. Text field about info for logging in.

id.description: Output only. An identifier for the `Instance`, generated by the backend.

createTime.description: Output only. Create a time stamp.

osImage.description: The OS image currently installed on the server.

StartInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to start a server.

sizeGb.description: The requested size of each LUN, in GB.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

enumDescriptions: NFS share can be mount with read-only permissions.
NFS share can be mount with read-write permissions.

shareIp.description: Output only. The IP address of the share on this network. Assigned automatically during provisioning based on the network's services_cidr.

noRootSquash.description: Disable root squashing, which is a feature of NFS. Root squash is a special mapping of the remote superuser (root) identity when using identity authentication.

nfsPath.description: Output only. The path to access NFS, in format shareIP:/InstanceID InstanceID is the generated ID instead of customer provided name. example like "10.0.0.0:/g123456789-nfs001"

allowedClientsCidr.description: The subnet of IP addresses permitted to access the share.

allowDev.description: Allow dev flag. Which controls whether to allow creation of devices.

network.description: The network the access point sits on.

AllowedClient.description: Represents an 'access point' for the share.

StopInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to stop a server.

RenameInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting rename of a server.

newInstanceId.description: Required. The new `id` of the instance.

supportedNetworkTemplates.description: Network templates that can be used with this OS Image.

applicableInstanceTypes.description: Instance types this image is applicable to. [Available types](https://cloud.google.com/bare-metal/docs/bms-planning#server_configurations)

name.description: Output only. OS Image's unique name.

userAccounts.description: Map of username to the user account info.

EnableHyperthreadingRequest.description: Message requesting to perform enable hyperthreading operation on a server.

required.description: If true, interface must have network connected.

name.description: Interface name. This is not a globally unique identifier. Name is unique only inside the ServerNetworkTemplate. This is of syntax or and forms part of the network template name.

DisableInteractiveSerialConsoleRequest.description: Message for disabling the interactive serial console on an instance.

EvictLunRequest.description: Request for skip lun cooloff and delete it.

availableMachineCount.description: Number of machines than can be created for the given location and instance_type.

name.description: Output only. The name of the instance quota.

gcpService.description: The gcp service of the provisioning quota.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, or empty if there are no more results in the list.

sshKeys.description: The SSH keys registered in the project.

newNfsshareId.description: Required. The new `id` of the nfsshare.

RenameNfsShareRequest.description: Message requesting rename of a server.

id.description: An identifier for the `Network`, generated by the backend.

vrfAttachment.description: Optional. The name of a pre-existing Vrf that the network should be attached to. Format is `vrfs/{vrf}`.

vlanId.description: The vlan id of the Network.

vrf.description: The Vrf for the Network. Use this only if a new Vrf needs to be created.

name.description: Output only. The resource name of this `Network`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/networks/{network}`

jumboFramesEnabled.description: Whether network uses standard frames or jumbo ones.

enumDescriptions: Client network, a network peered to a Google Cloud VPC.
Private network, a network local to the Bare Metal Solution environment.
The Network is in an unknown state.

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Network can only be connected to the assets (instances, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod.

servicesCidr.description: IP range for reserved for services (e.g. NFS).

mountPoints.description: Input only. List of mount points to attach the network to.

reservations.description: List of IP address reservations in this network. When updating this field, an error will be generated if a reservation conflicts with an IP address already allocated to a physical server.

ListVolumeSnapshotsResponse.description: Response message containing the list of volume snapshots.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results from the server.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

StopInstanceResponse.description: Response message from stopping a server.
